name: Ekibo
description: Ekibo was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space, famous for its farms and herdbeasts. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen were responsible for overthrowing a herdbeast-rustling ring there.
lead_paragraphs: Ekibo was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space, famous for its farms and herdbeasts. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen were responsible for overthrowing a herdbeast-rustling ring there.
